note: Radio stations. A station fixes its identity (genre, scene, era, tempo and mood range) and declares pools for everything that makes a sound; musicmaster.radio draws a coherent subset from those pools for each song, so consecutive songs differ in instrumentation, production, groove, delivery and key while staying in the genre. The planner owns tempo, structure and key, so no station fixes them. Run `python3 vocabulary/radio_stations.py` to check the document.
